name: browser-use
headline: Enterprise AI Skills - AI Tools for Operations
short_description: Enterprise AI skills for operations teams. Access McKinsey consulting frameworks, PM workflows, and practical tools. Currently supports Claude, with expansion to other LLMs. Integrates with Python workflows.
author: sruthir28

sections.overview:
Enterprise AI Skills bundles 13 consulting frameworks from McKinsey methodology into drop-in Claude skills for strategic thinking, decision-making, and presentation. The toolkit includes issue tree builders, hypothesis testing, synthesis, decision memos, storyline builders, and native PowerPoint deck generation with editable charts. Users run top-down workflows that transform fuzzy strategic questions into decision-shaped artifacts—from executive memos to board decks. Built for operations teams, PMs, and strategy leaders who need McKinsey-grade analysis and writing without the consulting retainer.
Break down complex strategic decisions using MECE issue trees
Generate McKinsey-style board decks with native editable charts and 4-agent critique pipeline
Write executive memos and decision documents that force yes/no commitments
Map stakeholders and prepare for high-stakes negotiations
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/sruthir28/enterprise-ai-skills`
sections.usage:
```
Act as an enterprise AI consultant for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] company. Use McKinsey consulting frameworks to analyze [DATA] and provide actionable insights. Focus on operational efficiency and strategic decision-making.
```
